newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets quiet in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets quiet in cautious trade.

text.p: Most West European cotton markets were quiet on Tuesday, reflecting an uncertain outlook for prices, trade sources said.
Some sellers were said to be holding back in expectations of tightening supplies of upland cotton as the season progresses.
A few reports of buying by spinning operations for first quarter shipment included Central Asian top grades, but interest in contracting any further forward was limited.
